# SimpleINSURE Brokerage LLC

> Independent New York property and casualty insurance broker in Garden City, NY (900 Stewart Ave Ste 210, Garden City, NY 11530; (516) 226-7969; info@simpleinsure.co). NY DFS license BR-1984615. Serves Nassau County, Suffolk County and New York City. Licensed in New York; this site does not offer coverage in other states.

We place commercial insurance for building owners, contractors, restaurants and small businesses, plus homeowners and personal umbrella coverage. We are usually paid a commission by the insurer. You can ask what we expect on your own policy. Coverage descriptions on this site are general summaries. The issued policy governs.

- [Free landlord policy checkup](https://www.simpleinsure.co/landlord-checkup/): send declarations pages and the property address. A licensed broker reviews the coverage and gets back to you. Free, no obligation.
- [Landlord insurance in Nassau and Suffolk County](https://www.simpleinsure.co/nassau-suffolk-landlord-insurance/): Long Island rental houses, two-family homes and small apartment buildings
